docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Paine's answer to Burke on the French Revolution: government rests on the consent of the governed, and its purpose is the common good.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Thomas Paine (1737–1809), Rights of Man, 1791–1792, in the edition of Moncure Daniel Conway (1832–1907). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
